sections.title: 7.1 What is a Context Window?
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **The context window is the maximum amount of text (in tokens) that an LLM can "see" and process at one time.**

### Analogy: The Whiteboard
> Imagine an LLM is a very smart consultant working at a whiteboard. The whiteboard has a limited size. You can write:
> - Your instructions
> - The conversation history
> - Documents you want analyzed
> - The question you're asking
> 
> Everything MUST fit on that whiteboard. If the whiteboard is full, you have to erase something to add more.

### Visual Representation
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  CONTEXT WINDOW                      │
│                  (e.g., 128,000 tokens)              │
│                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌───────────────┐  ┌───────────┐  │
│  │   SYSTEM    │  │ CONVERSATION  │  │  YOUR     │  │
│  │  PROMPT     │  │   HISTORY     │  │  CURRENT  │  │
│  │             │  │               │  │  QUESTION │  │
│  │ "You are    │  │ User: Hi      │  │           │  │
│  │  a helpful  │  │ AI: Hello!    │  │ "What is  │  │
│  │  assistant" │  │ User: ...     │  │  capital  │  │
│  │             │  │ AI: ...       │  │  of India"│  │
│  └─────────────┘  └───────────────┘  └───────────┘  │
│     500 tokens       120,000 tokens    50 tokens     │
│                                                      │
│  [▓▓▓▓▓░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░]  │
│                    Used: 1,500 tokens                │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Context Window Sizes (2024-2025)

| Model | Context Window | What Fits |
|-------|---------------|-----------|
| GPT-3.5 | 16K tokens | ~12,000 words |
| GPT-4 | 128K tokens | ~96,000 words (~100 page book) |
| Claude 3.5 | 200K tokens | ~150,000 words (~200 page book) |
| Gemini 1.5 Pro | 1M tokens | ~750,000 words (~700 page book) |
| Gemini 1.5 Ultra | 2M tokens | ~1.5M words |

### What Happens When Context Window is Full?

```
Option 1: TRUNCATION (cut old content)
[Old conv...] [New conv...] → Remove oldest messages
Risk: LLM "forgets" earlier conversation!

Option 2: SUMMARIZATION
Summarize old conversation → Keep summary in context
Better! But some details lost.

Option 3: RAG (Retrieval)
Don't put everything in context → Only retrieve relevant parts
Best for large documents!
```

### Why Context Window Matters
1. **Long documents**: Can you fit your entire document?
2. **Long conversations**: Does the LLM remember what was said earlier?
3. **Cost**: More tokens in context = more expensive per API call
4. **Speed**: Larger context = slower response
